title: दानबहादुरको रिट नृपध्वज निरौला र श्रीकान्त पौडेलको इजलासमा
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । निवर्तमान प्रहरी महानिरीक्षक दानबहादुर कार्कीको रिटमा आज सुनुवाइ हुने भएको छ । कार्कीको पेशी नृपध्वज निरौला र श्रीकान्त पौडेलको इजलाशमा परेको छ । सरकारले कात्तिक १८ गते मन्त्रिपरिषद् बैठकमार्फत दानबहादुर कार्कीलाई प्रहरी महानिरीक्षकको जिम्मेवारीबाट हटाएर प्रधानमन्त्रीको विशेष सुरक्षा सल्लाहकारमा सरुवा गर्दै एआईजी डा. मनोजकुमार केसीलाई आईजीपीमा बढुवा गरेको थियो । सरकारले गैरकानुनी रूपमा आफूलाई पदमुक्त गरेको दाबी गर्दै कार्कीले निर्णय बदर गरी आईजीपीमा पुनर्बहालीको मागसहित कात्तिक २० गते सर्वोच्च अदालतमा रिट दायर गरेका थिए । यसअघि मंसिर २ गते न्यायाधीश श्रीकान्त पौडेलको एकल इजलासले अल्पकालीन अन्तरिम आदेश नदिई दुवै पक्षलाई छलफलका लागि सोमबार (मंसिर ७) बोलाएको थियो। सर्वोच्च अदालतले मंसिर ४ गते आईजीपी डा. केसीका नाममा म्याद जारी गरेको थियो । अदालतको आदेशमा उल्लेख भएअनुसार म्याद बुझाउन अदालतका तामेलदार प्रहरी प्रधान कार्यालय पुग्दा कार्यालयका कर्मचारीले ‘सम्बन्धित व्यक्ति (आईजीपी) मिटिङमा जानुभएको छ, फर्केर आउनुहुन्छ’ भनी कार्यालय समयसम्म पर्खाएका थिए । तर, कार्यालय समय सकिँदासम्म पनि आईजीपी केसी उपस्थित नभएको र कार्यालयले समेत म्याद बुझ्न इन्कार गरेपछि तामेलदारले म्याद तामेल हुन नसकेको प्रतिवेदन अदालतमा पेस गरेका थिए। सोमबारको सुनुवाइका क्रममा विपक्षी प्रहरी प्रधान कार्यालयका तर्फबाट उपस्थित अधिवक्ताले म्याद ’प्राविधिक कारणले बुझ्न नसकिएको’ भन्दै पुनः म्याद जारी भए फिर्ता नहुने प्रतिबद्धतासहित इजलाससमक्ष अनुरोध गरेका थिए । सोही अनुरोधबमोजिम इजलासले प्रहरी प्रधान कार्यालयलाई प्रतिनिधित्व गर्ने अधिवक्तामार्फत नै मंसिर ४ गतेको म्याद बुझाई नियमानुसार पेस गर्न आदेश दिएको हो। इजलासले पेसीमा प्राथमिकता दिई पालो समेत आउने गरी आगामी मंसिर ९ गते बुधबार लागि अर्को पेसी तोक्न र सोको जानकारी महान्यायाधिवक्ताको कार्यालय समेतलाई दिन आदेश दिएको थियो। Kathmandu. The writ petition filed by outgoing Inspector General of Police Dan Bahadur Karki is scheduled to be heard today. Karki's appearance has been scheduled before a bench of Justices Nripadhwaj Niraula and Shrikant Poudel. The government had removed Dan Bahadur Karki from the post of Inspector General of Police through a cabinet meeting on Kartik 18 and transferred him to the post of Special Security Advisor to the Prime Minister, and promoted AIG Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to IGP. Claiming that the government had illegally removed him from the post, Karki had filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court on Kartik 20, seeking his reinstatement as IGP and quashing the decision. Earlier, on Mangsir 2, a single bench of Justice Shrikant Poudel had summoned both sides for discussions on Monday (Mangsir 7) without issuing a short-term interim order. The Supreme Court had issued a summons in the name of IGP Dr. KC on November 4. As mentioned in the court order, when the court's bailiff reached the police headquarters to serve the summons, the office staff had waited until office hours, saying, "The person concerned (IGP) has gone to a meeting and will return." However, IGP KC was not present even after the office hours ended and the office also refused to accept the summons, so the court clerk submitted a report to the court stating that the summons could not be served. During Monday's hearing, the lawyer representing the opposing Police Headquarters had requested the bench, stating that the deadline was 'unintelligible due to technical reasons' and promising not to withdraw it if it was reissued. In accordance with the same request, the bench ordered the Police Headquarters to submit the deadline on November 20 through the lawyer representing the same. The bench had ordered to schedule another hearing for Wednesday, November 21, giving priority to the case and also to inform the Attorney General's Office.

The writ petition filed by outgoing Inspector General of Police Dan Bahadur Karki is scheduled to be heard today. Karki's appearance has been scheduled before a bench of Justices Nripadhwaj Niraula and Shrikant Poudel. The government had removed Dan Bahadur Karki from the post of Inspector General of Police through a cabinet meeting on Kartik 18 and transferred him to the post of Special Security Advisor to the Prime Minister, and promoted AIG Dr. Manoj Kumar KC to IGP. Claiming that the government had illegally removed him from the post, Karki had filed a writ petition in the Supreme Court on Kartik 20, seeking his reinstatement as IGP and quashing the decision. Earlier, on Mangsir 2, a single bench of Justice Shrikant Poudel had summoned both sides for discussions on Monday (Mangsir 7) without issuing a short-term interim order. The Supreme Court had issued a summons in the name of IGP Dr. KC on November 4. As mentioned in the court order, when the court's bailiff reached the police headquarters to serve the summons, the office staff had waited until office hours, saying, "The person concerned (IGP) has gone to a meeting and will return." However, IGP KC was not present even after the office hours ended and the office also refused to accept the summons, so the court clerk submitted a report to the court stating that the summons could not be served. During Monday's hearing, the lawyer representing the opposing Police Headquarters had requested the bench, stating that the deadline was 'unintelligible due to technical reasons' and promising not to withdraw it if it was reissued. In accordance with the same request, the bench ordered the Police Headquarters to submit the deadline on November 20 through the lawyer representing the same. The bench had ordered to schedule another hearing for Wednesday, November 21, giving priority to the case and also to inform the Attorney General's Office.
